description: Resolve a podcast-feed URL the user can paste into Apple Podcasts, Overcast, Pocket Casts, or Spotify to receive every new Declassified case automatically. Also returns a JSON `episodes_url` the agent can poll, plus a `matched_so_far` count of cases that already mention the topic. Read-only — does NOT store the user's email or any PII; the RSS feed is the subscription. Public — no auth required.

email.description: Optional — informational only; no row is written for it.

topic.description: Topic the listener wants alerts for (e.g. 'UAP', 'JFK', 'COINTELPRO').

name: subscribe_declassified_topic
title: Subscribe to Declassified topic
